g.title: data_flows
g.text: TM-20260911-001 | Source-described data and control flows

g.title: note
g.text: No reader-to-shared write authority or cross-private mapping is shown.
No guest policy parser / SBI proxy / dynamic lifecycle is invented.
THREAT-019 also requires sensitive readable input and accepted
content freedom; no such carrier or recipient mismatch is proved.
Dashed flows are Inferred; other arrows describe source, not a run.
